slots.practicalActivity: In the Security Console, open a real Castellan Robotics Inc. user account and trace its full role-assignment list end to end, noting which roles came from a worker record and which (if any) look manually added, so you can see the user-accounts-to-roles relationship as real data instead of a diagram.
slots.deliverable: A written trace of one real user account's complete role list, with each role's origin (worker-driven vs. manual) noted.

lessons.title: Job Roles, Abstract Roles and Data Roles

slots.practicalActivity: Open the seeded Accounts Payable Specialist job role in the Security Console's role hierarchy visualization and trace the full chain downward -- which duty roles it inherits, and at least one privilege attached to one of those duty roles -- writing out the complete privilege to duty role to job role chain for a single real action, such as 'create an invoice.'
slots.deliverable: A written privilege-to-duty-role-to-job-role chain for one real AP action, traced entirely from the live role hierarchy rather than from memory.

slots.practicalActivity: Write out, for three real Castellan Robotics Inc. tickets you invent yourself, which diagnostic bucket each belongs in: 'can't reach the page at all' (function security) versus 'reaches the page but the data looks wrong or empty' (data security). Include at least one example of the classic 'pass function, fail data' combination, since the lesson calls that the most common and most misdiagnosed real-world complaint.
slots.deliverable: Three written tickets, each correctly bucketed as function security or data security, with one explicitly demonstrating the pass-function/fail-data pattern.

lessons.title: Data Security and Data Access Sets

slots.practicalActivity: In your practice environment, open Manage Data Access for Users and inspect Castellan Robotics Inc.'s default full-ledger data access set, then define a narrower data access set restricted to just the East Division's primary balancing segment value, read-only. Separately, check a Payables user's business unit assignment and confirm it scopes which invoices that user can see -- documenting the difference between the two scoping mechanisms on the same data.
slots.deliverable: One newly defined, narrower data access set (East Division, read-only) plus a written note on how it differs mechanically from a Payables business-unit scope.

slots.practicalActivity: Build one complete role assignment for a new Castellan Robotics Inc. hire -- user, role (General Ledger Accountant), security context (Data Access Set), and context value (the East Division data access set from the previous slot) -- all four parts explicit. Then open Manage Role Provisioning Rules and locate the role mapping that would autoprovision that exact role, confirming its conditions match the new hire's job and business unit.
slots.deliverable: One fully specified four-part role assignment plus the matching autoprovisioning role mapping you located and verified against it.

slots.practicalActivity: Run Simulate Navigator on the General Ledger Accountant role from the previous slot to confirm, without logging in as anyone, that it unlocks the expected menu items. Then sign in as (or provision) a matching test user account with the identical role and East Division data access set, and confirm the actual ledger rows that appear match what the data access set should allow.
slots.deliverable: One Simulate Navigator result confirming function security, plus one test-account sign-in confirming the actual visible data matches the assigned data access set.

lessons.title: General Ledger, Payables and Receivables Security

slots.practicalActivity: Build a reference map of the seeded job role hierarchy for all three modules at Castellan Robotics Inc. -- General Accounting Manager/General Accountant/Financial Analyst for GL, the four-level AP Manager-to-Specialist chain, and the AR Manager/Specialist pair -- noting for each pair which duty roles the manager role inherits beyond its specialist's.
slots.deliverable: A one-page job-role reference map across GL, AP, and AR, each manager-vs-specialist pair annotated with the duty roles the manager adds on top.

slots.practicalActivity: Define the SoD conflict rule 'create/edit a supplier AND approve supplier payments' as Castellan Robotics Inc. would, then run the User and Role Access Audit Report for a sample of Payables users (running Import User and Role Application Security Data first) and manually check the results against your rule to flag any user who holds both sides of the conflict.
slots.deliverable: One written SoD conflict rule plus a completed User and Role Access Audit Report review flagging any user (or confirming none) who holds both conflicting duties.

lessons.title: Role Design for a Real Company

slots.practicalActivity: Independently redo the lesson's Castellan Robotics Inc. four-person finance-team role design exercise for a second, different department you invent (e.g. a 3-person procurement team), following the full checklist: map people to seeded job roles, assign data access per role, check the combined design for SoD conflicts, and document any accepted conflict with a compensating control.
slots.deliverable: A complete role design for an original invented department, following all five checklist steps and documenting zero or one explicitly accepted-and-mitigated SoD conflict.

slots.practicalActivity: Submit a self-request for a self-requestable role as a Castellan Robotics Inc. test user, confirm it routes to the correct non-conflicting approver rather than the requester's own manager, and approve it. Then, using only the Lesson 17 function-vs-data troubleshooting method, diagnose a planted access problem (a role missing a duty role you remove yourself first) without being told the cause in advance.
slots.deliverable: One self-request routed through and approved by a correctly chosen approver, plus one independently diagnosed and resolved planted access problem, with the troubleshooting path documented step by step.

slots.practicalActivity: Course capstone lab: work through all four Castellan Robotics Inc. ticket scenarios from this chapter end to end using only the function-security/data-security split -- the missing autoprovisioning trigger, the stale business-unit assignment, the enterprise-structure setup gap disguised as a data problem, and the 'just grant him AP Manager' over-provisioning request -- reaching and documenting the real root cause and correct fix for each without taking the easy fix offered in the ticket.
slots.deliverable: A completed four-scenario troubleshooting runbook, each entry showing the diagnostic path taken, the real root cause found, and the specific (not over-broad) fix applied.

monthlyMilestoneContribution: After this course, a student can read and trace Oracle Fusion's full role model from privilege to user, configure business-unit and data-access-set scoping for GL/AP/AR, design a segregation-of-duties-clean role set for a real department, and independently diagnose and fix function-security versus data-security access problems using the same method a working Financials security consultant uses.
